notice_period.title: Statutory notice period acknowledgment

x-jsf-presentation.description:
Statutory notice period is mandatory under Honduran Labor Law. Either party may terminate the contract which written notice is:
  • No notice period: during probation
  • Less than three months - 24-hour notice
  • Three to six months - one weeks' notice
  • Between six months and one year - two weeks' notice
  • Between one year and two years - one months' notice
  • More than two years - two months' notice

overtime_pay_confirmation.description: According to the Honduran Work Code, overtime must be paid at a surcharge. The ordinary daytime shift cannot exceed eight hours per day and 44 hours per week. The ordinary night shift cannot exceed six hours per day and 36 hours a week. Daytime work happens between 5:00 AM and 7:00 PM. Nighttime work happens between 7:00 PM and 5:00 AM. In the employment contract, it is understood that the employee agrees to work outside of normal working hours if required by business conditions. Overtime pay is calculated as follows: - 125% of the employee's salary when overtime takes place during the daytime - 150% of the employee's salary when overtime hours occur during a night period - 175% of the employee's salary when overtime hours are a prolongation of a night shift.

salary_pay_illness_confirmation.description: In the event that the employee is unable to perform the duties due to illness or disability, they are entitled to the gross salary payment compliantly with the social security provisions in the Honduran law: - from the 1st to the 3rd day of illness or disability the employer pays 100% of their gross salary. - from the 4th day until 52 weeks of illness or disability the employer pays 34% of their gross salary, and the Social Security Institution pays for the remaining 66%. - after 52 weeks of illness or disability the work contract is interrupted until the sick leave is over
salary_pay_illness_confirmation.title: Salary payment during employee's illness

x-jsf-presentation.description:
In the event that the employee is unable to perform the duties due to illness or disability, they are entitled to the gross salary payment compliantly with the social security provisions in the Honduran law:
  • from the 1st to the 3rd day of illness or disability the employer pays 100% of their gross salary
  • from the 4th day until 52 weeks of illness or disability the employer pays 34% of their gross salary, and the Social Security Institution pays for the remaining 66%
  • after 52 weeks of illness or disability the work contract is interrupted until the sick leave is over
